title: Shimabara Rebellion
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Shimabara Rebellion", at revision 1373667124, opens: "The Shimabara Rebellion , also known as the Shimabara-Amakusa Rebellion  or Shimabara-Amakusa Ikki (島原･天草一揆), was an uprising that occurred in the Shimabara Domain of the Tokugawa shogunate in Japan from 17 December 1637 to 15 April 1638." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q696217, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1637 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
